---
title: A deck that names a project copy in revealjs-plugins only
author: Test Author
date: 2026-01-01
engine: markdown
format:
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The project copy of veil is named in revealjs-plugins but not in filters, so the embedded filter runs with the plugin of the copy, and the deck warns once.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: '\[embedded\] veil: .*in `revealjs-plugins` but not in `filters`.*Name the copy in both lists\.'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="veil-config"', 'reveal-veil/veil-plugin-stub\.js']
        - ['id="project-veil"']
---
